new_candidates.date_enacted: Adopted on final hearing 2026-06-08 by the Nassau County Board of County Commissioners (motion by Commissioner Gray, seconded by Commissioner Farmer, approved); first reading was 2026-05-11, following direction to draft on 2026-04-13.
new_candidates.duration: 12 months from the effective date, or until an ordinance amending the Comprehensive Plan, Land Development Regulations, and/or Code of Ordinances relating to Data Center Facilities takes effect, whichever occurs first (Ordinance 2026-044, Section 6). Effective date is upon filing with the Florida Secretary of State per s. 125.66.
new_candidates.legal_basis: Nassau County Ordinance No. 2026-044, "Imposing a Temporary Moratorium on the Acceptance, Review, or Approval of Applications for Development Permits, Development Orders, Rezoning, or Site Plans Related to Data Centers, Data Processing Facilities, Data Mining or Cryptocurrency Mining Operations ... Within Unincorporated Nassau County, Florida."
new_candidates.trigger: Board directed staff to draft the moratorium in April 2026 to allow time to study and adopt comprehensive-plan and land-development-code provisions for data centers before accepting further applications; a companion resolution (2026-102) created a Fact-Finding Committee on Data Center Development that met repeatedly through June 2026.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31. Checked the June 22, July 13, and July 27, 2026 BOCC agendas; no repeal, amendment, or extension item found. Applies only to unincorporated Nassau County.
new_candidates.affected_projects: No specific pending project named in the ordinance itself; adopted preemptively alongside the Fact-Finding Committee on Data Center Development.
new_candidates.outcome: Ordinance adopted on final hearing 2026-06-08; moratorium in effect for up to 12 months or until permanent Data Center Facility regulations are adopted, whichever is sooner.

new_candidates.date_enacted: 2026-05-19, Barnes County Commission (Valley City, ND), motion by Pete Paulson, seconded by Mike Schwehr, passed 5-0.
new_candidates.legal_basis: Barnes County Commission motion adopting a six-month moratorium on new data center building permits/applications countywide, per official commission minutes; no separately numbered resolution/ordinance was cited in the minutes.
new_candidates.trigger: Preemptive: no data center project was formally pending, but the board acted on rumor of a possible project in southern Barnes County to allow time to draft zoning/ordinance regulations before any application could be filed. Several citizens asked the board to extend the pause to a full year, but the motion that passed and was recorded was for six months.

new_candidates.affected_projects: None formally pending; rumored project in southern Barnes County cited as the impetus.
new_candidates.outcome: Commission unanimously approved a six-month moratorium on new data center building permits/applications countywide effective 2026-05-19.

new_candidates.date_enacted: 2026-06-08, Hazle Township (Luzerne County) Board of Supervisors, unanimous vote adopting a curative amendment.
new_candidates.legal_basis: Municipal curative amendment adopted by the Hazle Township Board of Supervisors, temporarily invalidating portions of the township zoning ordinance for 180 days on the stated grounds that the ordinance is deficient because it does not address data centers (instrument number not located).
new_candidates.trigger: Followed sustained community opposition ("Project Hazelnot") to NorthPoint Development's proposed ~1,300-acre, 15-building "Project Hazelnut" data-center campus with substation, which the township had already rejected in November 2025 and which a Luzerne County judge ruled against in spring 2026.
new_candidates.affected_projects: NorthPoint Development's proposed 'Project Hazelnut' data-center campus, previously denied by the township and by a county court.
new_candidates.outcome: Board of Supervisors unanimously adopted a 180-day curative amendment pausing consideration of new data-center applications while permanent zoning language is drafted.
